name: STRATO
desc: Berlin web hosting, domain and cloud storage provider with about 2 million customer contracts and 4 million managed domains.
products: Hosting, domains, HiDrive cloud storage, servers, website builder
customers: Consumers and small businesses; about 2 million customer contracts
parent_ultimate: IONOS Group SE (majority-owned by United Internet)
marketing_autonomy_basis: Own brand and site, but management board is staffed by IONOS group executives
stores_or_sites: 100,000+ physical and virtual servers in data centres in Germany and the EU
markets: Germany, Netherlands, Spain, Sweden and other European markets

signals.what: New managing director Dr. Jens Reich (also IONOS CCO)

fit_rationale: Known German consumer hosting brand, but run by IONOS executives with 350 staff and no stand-alone revenue published; a sponsorship decision would likely sit with IONOS.
